'''Squad B''' was a formation of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] personnel assigned to the ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]''. They participated in the defense of the vessel during its [[Battle for Black Ice|invasion]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
